newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ifo sees German investment growth up only slightly.
newsitem.headline: Ifo sees German investment growth up only slightly.

text.p: West German industry plans only a small increase in overall investment growth this year from last year's disappointing levels, the Ifo economic research institute said on Sunday.

The Munich-based institute said results of a survey it conducted showed that investment budgets this year have grown by six percent, lower than the seven percent that was expected, and only just above last year's increase of five percent.
During the next four years, the survey showed that west German companies expect sales to grow a nominal annual average of four percent and a seasonally adjusted 2.75 percent.
Ifo said exports would continue to be the primary economic engine with domestic sales expected to grow only one percent this year and perhaps three percent in 1998.

The institute said that the data painted bleak prospects for German employment. The west German companies surveyed said they would reduce staffing three precent this year and a further one percent in 1998.
Ifo blamed the weak investment outlook on the overall economic environment in Germany and said politicians needed to reform the nation's tax structure.
